messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: new variable
parts:
On 11/11/2012 11:56 AM, ya wrote:
> Hi list,
> Is it possible to temporarily generate new variables, for instance, the
> interaction terms between certain variables using lavaan, without saving
> the new variables in the data frame?

No, but I do not see a need for this. In an R session, you can easily
add the interaction term to the data.frame, and if you don't save this
changed data.frame, the interaction term will be lost if you close the
session. So in a sense, it is temporarily.

Yves.
